note: Edges use existing atlas nodes feedback and oscillation where they exist; chaos-threebody is a new concept id.

description.zh: 确定的规则也能产生无法长期预测的行为：误差按 e^{λt} 放大（λ > 0），可预测期限只与精度的对数成正比；洛伦兹吸引子与三体 8 字轨道是典型例子。数值模型，长轨迹细节不可信。
description.en: Deterministic rules can produce behaviour that cannot be predicted long term: errors grow like e^{λt} with λ > 0, and the prediction horizon is proportional only to the logarithm of the precision; the Lorenz attractor and the three-body figure-8 are typical examples. A numerical model; fine detail of long trajectories is not trustworthy.

label.en: The other side of nonlinear systems

reason.zh: 线性振动的行为规则可预测；加上非线性后，同样用微分方程描述的系统可以出现对初值极度敏感的混沌。
reason.en: Linear oscillation is regular and predictable; add nonlinearity and systems described by the same kind of differential equations can become chaotic, extremely sensitive to the starting point.

label.zh: 反馈会放大也会压制误差
label.en: Feedback can amplify or damp errors

reason.zh: 反馈使误差按 e^{λt} 变化：λ < 0 时压制（稳定），λ > 0 时放大（混沌），是同一个指数在两种符号下的结果。
reason.en: Feedback makes errors evolve like e^{λt}: damped for λ < 0 (stable) and amplified for λ > 0 (chaos), the same exponent with two signs.

title.zh: 为什么天气只能预报几天？
title.en: Why can weather be forecast only a few days ahead?
